long_biography.plain_text:
Lao moved from rural Almería to Terrassa with his family at twelve. He completed industrial studies and worked in electrical manufacturing, hospitality and property before entering Spain’s newly liberalised gaming market. With his brother Juan, he began operating amusement machines and expanded into casinos, bingo halls and sports betting, turning Cirsa into a multinational business.

The sale of Cirsa to Blackstone ended four decades of founder control and opened a second phase centred on capital allocation. As chairman and controlling shareholder of Nortia, Lao oversees a family portfolio spanning listed companies, private-equity funds, property, hotels, agriculture, food, financial services and startups. His son serves as chief executive, separating family ownership and strategic stewardship from daily management.
long_biography.html:
Lao moved from rural Almería to Terrassa with his family at twelve. He completed industrial studies and worked in electrical manufacturing, hospitality and property before entering Spain’s newly liberalised gaming market. With his brother Juan, he began operating amusement machines and expanded into casinos, bingo halls and sports betting, turning Cirsa into a multinational business.

The sale of Cirsa to Blackstone ended four decades of founder control and opened a second phase centred on capital allocation. As chairman and controlling shareholder of Nortia, Lao oversees a family portfolio spanning listed companies, private-equity funds, property, hotels, agriculture, food, financial services and startups. His son serves as chief executive, separating family ownership and strategic stewardship from daily management.
